manifest.name: wayfinder-dashboard
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件 / DeepSeek Harness plugin: Wayfinder decision-map dashboard. Every question stays visible; dependencies gate execution only.
manifest.author: gyanano <1624055384@qq.com>

bundle.text:
# wayfinder-dashboard — bundle patch layer.
#
# Applied after the bundles it sits behind in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`
# list (put it after @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app so the webserver, tools and client
# module roster already exist). Later layers win, and a patch replaces a row's
# whole `config`, so this file only inserts and never restates a base row.
#
# One row is enough. The package is dual-face: this entry loads the host half
# (`main`), and the client-modules node half scans the same entry for the
# `dsh.client` declaration and serves its `./client` bundle to the browser.
# The bundled Wayfinder skill provider is mounted by the host half as a child
# plugin rather than a second row here, so it can resolve its own directory
# from `import.meta.url` instead of a fragile path expression in YAML.

- insert:
    - id: wayfinder-dashboard
      name: 'wayfinder-dashboard'
      config:
        # Where maps live. Empty means `$DSH_HOME/wayfinder`, which is outside
        # your repo on purpose — a Wayfinder map is planning material and should
        # not land in a commit or a public tracker. Inside it, maps are filed
        # per workspace under `workspaces/<workspaceKey>/maps/`, so one project's
        # maps never show up in another's.
        dataDir: ''


        # Mount the bundled copy of the upstream Wayfinder skill as an extra
        # skill provider, so an agent working the map reads the same rules the
        # dashboard is drawn from.
        mountBundledSkill: true

readme.text:
**DeepSeek Harness 插件**

[English](README.en.md)

把 Matt Pocock 的 [Wayfinder](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/main/docs/engineering/wayfinder.md) 做成一张可交互的**决定图**：节点是问题，边是依赖，人来做决定，Agent 负责推导下一层。

需要已安装 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）`0.1.0-rc.7` 或兼容版本。

装进你平时用的 Web 配置即可，**不用改配置文件，也不用另开 profile**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Gyanano/wayfinder-dashboard
```

然后和平时一样启动：

```sh
dsh
```

侧栏最下方会出现 **Wayfinder 地图**。打开一个工作区，在右侧输入框输入：

```
/wf-chart 我们想做插件，但路还看不清
```

Agent 会在当前会话里画出第一层问题。点开节点，用 `/wf-decide` 记下决定；用 `/wf-research` 派研究；用 `/wf-advance` 推进一步。顶栏可以把当前地图导出成 PNG。

Wayfinder 规划的是「一次会话装不下」的工作。图上的节点是**决策票**——答案必须是一个决定，而不是「去实现 X」。

- 地图属于**一个工作区**。一个仓库可以同时有好几张图，一张图对准一个目的地；在这个仓库画的图不会跑到另一个仓库里。
- 打开插件先看到**这个工作区的列表**，点进去才是图。没有图时是一段说明，不是演示数据。
- 图自上而下读：**起点**（最初那句模糊想法）→ 已经问清的一层 → **迷雾**（下一层还没推导出来）→ **目的地**。
- **一次只长一层**。下一层长什么样，取决于这一层怎么落地。
- 每个问题**随时能看见、能点开**；依赖只挡住执行，不挡住阅读。
- 研究只带回**证据**，不替你做决定。

语义见 [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md)，视觉见 [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md)。

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/wf-chart <想法>` | 开一张新图，并让 Agent 推导第一层 |
| `/wf-decide <决定>` | 记下当前选中问题的决定，并推进下一层 |
| `/wf-research [说明]` | 把当前问题派给 Agent 做研究 |
| `/wf-advance` | 让 Agent 只推当前前沿一步 |
| `/wf-ask <问题>` | 手动加一个问题 |
| `/wf-focus` | 在当前图上选中一个问题 |
| `/wf-scope [in\|out]` | 把问题划进或划出范围 |
| `/wf-reopen` | 重新打开一个已经记下的决定 |

一般不用动。需要时写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖这一行。

| 项 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/wayfinder` | 地图文件目录，刻意放在仓库外面 |
| `mountBundledSkill` | `true` | 挂上自带的 Wayfinder skill |

readme.section: Agent 能做什么、不能做什么
readme.text:
Agent 可以列图、读图、更新目的地和迷雾、增改问题、认领并汇报研究。

**没有「替人做决定」的工具。** HITL 问题只能你在输入框里用 `/wf-decide` 收束。

```sh
npm test
```

浏览器对照需要本机已启动 Harness，再跑 `node test/browser/verify.mjs`。
MIT。自带的上游 Wayfinder skill 为 MIT © 2026 Matt Pocock，见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

**A DeepSeek Harness plugin**

[中文](README.md)

Turns Matt Pocock's [Wayfinder](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/main/docs/engineering/wayfinder.md) into an interactive **decision map**: nodes are questions, edges are dependencies, humans decide, and the agent derives the next layer.

Requires [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) `0.1.0-rc.7` or compatible.

Add it to the Web profile you already use. **No config file edits, no extra profile:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Gyanano/wayfinder-dashboard
```

Then start Harness the way you always do:

```sh
dsh
```

**Wayfinder map** appears at the foot of the sidebar. Open a workspace and type in the host composer:

```
/wf-chart we want plugins but the route from here is foggy
```

The agent charts the first layer in the current session. Click a question and record a decision with `/wf-decide`; dispatch research with `/wf-research`; nudge the frontier with `/wf-advance`. The header can export the open map as a PNG.
Wayfinder plans work that does not fit in one agent session. Nodes are **decision tickets** — the resolution is a decision, never "go implement X".

- A map belongs to **one workspace**. One repo can hold several maps; one map has one destination; a map from this repo never appears in another.
- Opening the plugin shows **this workspace's list**. A graph appears only after you pick a map. No maps means short tips, not a demo.
- Read the map top to bottom: **Start** (the fuzzy idea) → the layer that has been specified → **fog** (the next layer is not derived yet) → **Destination**.
- It grows **one layer at a time**. What the next layer asks depends on how this one lands.
- Every question is **always visible and openable**. Dependencies gate execution, not seeing.
- Research returns **evidence**, never a decision.
Semantics live in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md); the visual system in [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/wf-chart <idea>` | Chart a new map and have the agent derive the first layer |
| `/wf-decide <decision>` | Record a decision on the selected question and grow the next layer |
| `/wf-research [brief]` | Dispatch research on the selected question |
| `/wf-advance` | Have the agent work one step of the current frontier |
| `/wf-ask <question>` | Add a question by hand |
| `/wf-focus` | Focus a question on the current map |
| `/wf-scope [in\|out]` | Rule a question in or out of scope |
| `/wf-reopen` | Reopen a recorded decision |

You can leave the defaults. Override the row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` only if you need to.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/wayfinder` | Where map files live, outside your repo on purpose |
| `mountBundledSkill` | `true` | Mount the bundled Wayfinder skill |

readme.section: What an agent can and cannot do
readme.text:
An agent can list and read maps, update destination and fog, add or edit questions, and claim and report research.

**There is no tool that decides a question.** HITL tickets only resolve when you type `/wf-decide`.

```sh
npm test
```

Browser checks need a running Harness, then `node test/browser/verify.mjs`.
